data/tasks/a-backup.sh.text:
#!/bin/sh
export SPAWNLOFT_DATA_ROOT='<run>/data'
export HOME='<run>/home'
export APPDATA='<run>/home/AppData/Roaming'
export XDG_CONFIG_HOME='<run>/home/.config'
export XDG_DATA_HOME='<run>/home/.local/share'
exec '<core>' task run 'a-backup'

home/.config/systemd/user/spawnloft-5b27.text:
[Unit]
Description=SpawnLoft task a-backup

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/bin/sh "<run>/data/tasks/a-backup.sh"
WorkingDirectory=<run>/data
KillMode=process
StandardOutput=append:<run>/data/tasks/a-backup.stdout.log
StandardError=append:<run>/data/tasks/a-backup.stderr.log

[Unit]
Description=SpawnLoft schedule a-backup

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 04:00:00
Persistent=true
AccuracySec=1s

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
